faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital (BMH Delhi), a government organization located in Delhi. It offers opportunities for medical professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery). This is a specialized role within the dental department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post in this recruitment drive by BMH Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for BMH Delhi Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the BMH Delhi Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and submit the application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post is 12 September 2026. Applicants should ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post must possess an MDS degree from a recognized university or institute in the relevant speciality.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post is 45 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 Per Month, along with other applicable benefits.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BMH Delhi Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident (Dental - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) post includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.
